messages:
anya_support: Heads up — Euris procurement is holding payment until Redwood is registered as a vendor in their Coupa instance and an official PO is uploaded. They say the signed SOW + draft PO we have isn't enough. Ticket #INC-7221.

mike_ae: they gave a draft PO but procurement insists on vendor code in Coupa + signed PO PDF with procurement approver stamp. AP wants the invoice uploaded to Coupa by the vendor (not emailed). Euris AP: AP-invoices@euris.eu, cost center = CC-91.

sarah_euris: Confirming from my side — Monique (procurement) will only accept invoices that reference the PO number in the "PO Ref" field and are uploaded through our Coupa vendor portal. They also require the invoice date to be on or after the PO effective date. Happy to share Monique's email if that helps. :eyes:

josh_billing: Ok. Two practical asks from finance to get vendor code created: 1) completed vendor registration form (attached), 2) tax docs (W-9 or EU VAT cert) + bank wiring details. Can someone from sales send the registration form and the company's VAT cert?

mike_ae: I have a scanned copy of the signed SOW and our bank details. No W-9 (we're a non-US EU entity) — we have a VAT registration (VAT ID: EU123456789). I'll attach. Also note: Coupa requires the external invoice reference to be exactly EURI-PROJ-789 for this PO.

finance-bot: Proforma created: /invoices/proforma/PR-23678 (expires in 14 days). Proforma shows net amount and payment instructions.

anya_support: Quick sample of the minimal payload Coupa wants when vendor uploads (per Monique):
```
{
  "po_number": "EURI-PROJ-789",
  "invoice_date": "2026-05-02",
  "invoice_number": "PRO-23678",
  "line_items": [ { "description": "Redwood Dedicated - May", "amount": "12500.00" } ],
  "custom_fields": { "cost_center": "CC-91" }
}
```

josh_billing: We cannot raise the final invoice until the PO is uploaded and vendor code exists. Options: 1) Send a proforma (done), 2) complete vendor registration immediately so they can create vendor code and upload PO, or 3) ask procurement to accept emailed invoice (unlikely). Recommend option 2 + follow-up with Monique. :white_check_mark:

mike_ae: I'll ping Monique now and confirm whether they can expedite vendor registration once we submit the form. I'll also ask whether AP will accept an interim invoice referencing the proforma number while waiting for PO entry.

sarah_euris: Monique replied — they will start vendor onboarding once they get the registration form + VAT cert. They said they can create the PO within 48 business hours afterward. Monique's note: vendor must register and then upload invoice referencing PO; matching is strict (PO Ref must equal EURI-PROJ-789).

anya_support: Summary / next steps: 1) Mike to send vendor registration + VAT cert to Monique (in progress). 2) Josh holds final invoicing until Coupa PO upload — proforma attached for records. 3) Support to mark ticket INC-7221 as pending procurement and set a 3-day follow-up. I'll update the customer once the PO is visible.

mike_ae: Sent registration + VAT cert to Monique (email thread attached). Will post updates here when PO is created. :thumbsup:

josh_billing: Once Monique confirms PO is live, reply here and I'll finalize and upload the invoice with the exact PO Ref / cost center. Leaving ticket pending.

anya_support: Thanks all — closing the loop in Slack for now. If Monique asks for additional compliance docs (e.g., vendor questionnaire), we'll treat as blocker and escalate to legal.
